rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angels trusted their many acts of obedience and presumed sinlessness, so they magnified themselves and belittled Adam when questioning his appointment as vicegerent.
rows.anchor: لما نظروا إلى كثرة طاعتهم واستعداد عصمتهم ونظروا إلى نتائج الصفات النفسانية استعظموا أنفسهم واستصغروا آدم وذريته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israelites made the same entitlement argument against Talut; God answered that kingship rests on divine choice and superiority in knowledge and physique, not wealth.
rows.anchor: قالوا أنى يكون له الملك علينا ونحن أحق بالملك منه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's answer to the angels is expanded by Adam's election, teaching him the names, and creating him with His hands: succession is bestowed by God, not earned through abundant worship.
rows.anchor: ليعلموا أن استعداد ملك الخلافة واستحقاقها ليس بكثرة الطاعات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the angels boasted, God favored Adam with knowledge of the names; their prostration showed that God needs no service and that grace belongs to Him.
rows.anchor: فبتفاخرهم على آدم صاروا ساجدين له ليعلموا أن الحق تعالى مستغن عن طاعتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's knowledge of Adam also includes hidden faults unknown to angels: bodily dispositions shared with animals and vices produced by the commanding self when the spirit follows it without the discipline of sacred law.
rows.anchor: له رذائل وأوصاف مذمومة لا يعلمها الملائكة لأنهم لا يعلمون منه أوصافا مذمومة هي من نتائج قالبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those soul-born faults include vanity, ostentation, seeking reputation, envy, preferring worldly life, innovation, deviation, and holding evil opinions.
rows.anchor: من العجب والرياء والسمعة والحسد واشتراء الحياة الدنيا بالآخرة والابتداع

rows.speaker: وهب بن منبه
rows.claim: Wahb reports that God told the earth He would make a vicegerent from it; some descendants would enter Paradise and others Hell, prompting the earth to protest that it would produce someone destined for the Fire.
rows.anchor: قال وهب بن منبه : لما أراد الله أن يخلق آدم

rows.speaker: وهب بن منبه
rows.claim: The earth wept at this prospect, and springs burst from it and continued to flow until the Day of Resurrection.
rows.anchor: فبكت فانفجرت منها العيون إلى يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel was sent to gather soil from the earth's four corners and varieties, but withdrew after it appealed to God; a Persian couplet notes that approaching a ruler brings many benefits but also danger.
rows.anchor: فرجع جبريل عليه السلام إلى مكانه ولم يأخذ منها شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Michael and then Israfil received the same plea from the earth and each returned without taking soil.
rows.anchor: فأرسل الله ميكائيل عليه السلام فلما انتهى إليها قالت الأرض له كما قالت لجبريل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Persian couplet says there are abundant benefits in approaching a ruler, but safety lies in staying away from him.
rows.anchor: بدريا در منافع بيشمارست اكرخوا هي سلامت در كنارست

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Angel of Death invoked God's authority, took a handful from the earth's four corners, and gathered about forty cubits of soil; the soil's differing colors and qualities account for human diversity.
rows.anchor: فقبض قبضة من وجه الأرض مقدار أربعين ذراعا من زواياها الأربع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each particle in the gathered handful became the origin of a human body, and after death a person is buried where that soil was taken.
rows.anchor: فصار كل ذرة من تلك القبضة أصل بدن للإنسان فإذا مات يدفن في الموضع الذي أخذت منه

rows.speaker: روضة العلماء
rows.claim: A report says the earth complained that soil had been taken from it; God promised to return something better and purer, which the author links to embalming the dead with musk and ghaliya.
rows.anchor: قال في "روضة العلماء" : فشكت الأرض إلى الله تعالى

rows.speaker: كشف الكنوز
rows.claim: Kashf al-kunuz reports broad scholarly agreement that all names were divinely taught: God created in Adam necessary knowledge of words and the meanings they denote.
rows.anchor: قال في "كشف الكنوز" اتفق جم غفير من أهل العلم

rows.speaker: خبر
rows.claim: A report says God placed the secrets of letters in Adam alone; letters emerged on his tongue in many languages and were formed into images and shapes for him.
rows.anchor: وفي الخبر لما خلق الله آدم بث فيه أسرار الأحرف ولم يبث في أحد من الملائكة

rows.speaker: خبر
rows.claim: A report says Adam learned seven hundred thousand languages, lost all but Arabic after eating from the tree, then recovered them when chosen as a prophet; speaking his descendants' languages was among his miracles.
rows.anchor: وفي الخبر علمه سبعمائة ألف لغة فلما وقع في أكل الشجرة سلب اللغات إلا العربية

rows.speaker: بعض المفسرين
rows.claim: Some exegetes say Adam learned a thousand trades and taught his children to seek worldly livelihood through crafts rather than religion; they list Adam as farmer, Noah as carpenter, Idris as tailor, Salih as merchant, David as armorer, Solomon as basket maker, and several prophets as shepherds.
rows.anchor: قال بعض المفسرين : علم الله آدم ألف حرفة

rows.speaker: حديث
rows.claim: A report says the best men's work is tailoring and the best women's work is spinning; the text also says Muhammad did much of the household tailoring.
rows.anchor: وفي الحديث "عمل الأبرار من الرجال الخياطة وعمل الأبرار من النساء الغزل"

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The comprehensive wording includes names of creatures and names of God; if knowledge of creaturely names warrants the angels' prostration, knowledge of God's names warrants it even more.
rows.anchor: فكما علمه أسماء المخلوقات علمه أسماء الحق تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine plural pronoun in the account of displaying the names is used because rational beings occur among the named things and take grammatical precedence.
rows.anchor: وإنما ذكر الضمير لأن في المسميات العقلاء فغلبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To display something is to show it to another so that the viewer can recognize its condition.
rows.anchor: والعرض إظهار الشيء للغير ليعرف العارض منه حاله

rows.speaker: حديث
rows.claim: A report says God displayed the named beings in forms as small as particles of dust.
rows.anchor: وفي الحديث "أنه عرضهم أمثال الذر"

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Possibly God displayed one representative from each kind so the angels could learn the states and rules of the rest from it.
rows.anchor: ولعله عز وجل عرض عليهم من أفراد كل نوع ما يصلح أن يكون أنموذجا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Teaching and displaying the names honored and elected Adam, disclosed hidden knowledge through a chosen servant, prevented angels and others from claiming superior knowledge, and manifested God's encompassing mercy.
rows.anchor: والحكمة في التعليم والعرض تشريف آدم واصطفاؤه وإظهاره الأسرار والعلوم المكنونة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to inform God was meant to rebuke and disable the angels, not to obtain an answer; such an impossible command can expose incapacity, as with image makers told to revive their creations on Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: تبكيتا وتعجيزا للملائكة وخطاب التعجيز جائز وهو الأمر بإتيان الشيء ولم يكن إتيانه مرادا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The challenge asks for the names of the existing beings and tests the angels' claim that they deserved vicegerency more than God's chosen appointee.
rows.anchor: في زعمكم أنكم أحقاء بالخلافة ممن استخلفته كما ينبىء عنه مقالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse shows that, after knowledge of divine unity, learning language is among the most valuable sciences, since God demonstrated Adam's superiority through it.
rows.anchor: هذه الآية دليل على أن أولى الأشياء بعد علم التوحيد تعلم علم اللغة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anyone claiming superiority must supply evidence: the angels were asked for proof, and their speculation about unseen corruption was answered by their ignorance of names of what they could actually see.
rows.anchor: دلت أيضا على أن المدعي يطالب بالحجة فإن الملائكة ادعوا الفضل فطولبوا بالبرهان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage rebukes claimants and knowers alike: if people cannot name what they see, they should not presume to judge what they cannot see; knowledge should lead to love, and love to obedience.
rows.anchor: لا تعلمون أسماء ما تعاينون فكيف تتكلمون في فساد من لا تعاينون

rows.speaker: أبو بكر الواسطي
rows.claim: Al-Wasiti says knowing God necessarily leads to loving Him, love to remembering Him, remembrance to tasting its sweetness, and that sweetness makes one turn away from other things.
rows.anchor: قال أبو بكر الواسطي : من المحال أن يعرفه العبد ثم لا يحبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Persian couplet compares human beings to a child who cries for a compassionate nurse's milk: one must cry and listen so that divine bounty may flow.
rows.anchor: طفل يك روزه همي داند طريق كه بكيرم تارسد دايه شفيق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After Adam's descent, God promised that inspiration and revelation would continue for him and his descendants through prophets, revelation, and revealed books.
rows.anchor: أن الله تعالى لما ابتلى آدم بالهبوط إلى الأرض بشره بأن إلهامه ووحيه لا ينقطع عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who follow guidance as Adam did cultivate the seed of love through repentance, lamentation, weeping, forgiveness-seeking, obedience, and worship until it yields divine unity and knowledge.
rows.anchor: فمن تبع هداي كما تبعه آدم بالتوبة والنوح والبكاء والاستغفار وتربية بذر المحبة بالطاعة والعبودية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guided people need not fear losing their eternal potential to animal and predatory traits or grieve their earthly descent, because divine care returns them to the highest sacred stations.
rows.anchor: فلا خوف عليهم في المستقبل من وبال إفساد بذر المحبة من طينة الصفات الحيوانية والسبعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Disbelievers cover the seed of love with attachments to carnal desires and ruin their innate potential by rejecting clear signs out of human ignorance.
rows.anchor: {والذين كفروا} أي : ستروا بذر المحبة بتعلقات الشهوات النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's signs here include prophetic miracles, revealed books, and inspiration and guidance that cultivate love and the human tree toward unity, knowledge, nearness, and Paradise.
rows.anchor: أي : معجزات أنبيائنا وكتبنا وما أنزلنا على الأنيباء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers remain in Hell because they stay in the realm of nature, follow desires, and fail to nourish love's seed through sacred law, thereby ruining their capacity for eternal bliss.
rows.anchor: لأنهم خلدوا في أرض الطبيعة واتبعوا أهواءهم فما نبت بذر محبتهم بماء الشريعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The plural address Banu Israel covers males and females when mixed; Israel is Jacob, and the Hebrew elements mean servant of God.
rows.anchor: البنون اسم للذكور والإناث إذا اجتمعوا وإسرائيل اسم يعقوب عليه السلام ومعناه عبد الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address targets Jews around Medina, including Banu Qurayza and Banu al-Nadir, descendants of Jacob; they are singled out as exceptionally blessed yet especially ungrateful.
rows.anchor: والخطاب لليهود المعاصرين للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم الذين كانوا حوالي المدينة من بني قريظة والنضير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembering with the first vocalization of dhikr means retaining blessings in the heart; the other vocalization includes spoken remembrance, so the command calls for inward preservation and verbal thanks.
rows.anchor: الذكر بضم الذال بالقلب خاصة بمعنى الحفظ الذي يضاد النسيان والذكر بكسر الذال يقع على الذكر باللسان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The singular word for favor is a collective noun, as in the verse about being unable to count God's favors; the phrase bestowed upon you implies they had forgotten the favors entirely.
rows.anchor: لأن النعمة اسم جنس بمعنى الجمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning favors bestowed on them counters natural envy: people should not look at those with greater worldly wealth and despise their own blessings, but should see their own gifts and give thanks.
rows.anchor: لأن الإنسان غيور حسود بالطبع فإذا نظر إلى ما أنعم الله على غيره حمله الغيرة والحسد

rows.speaker: أرباب المعاني
rows.claim: The people of spiritual meanings say God linked Israel to remembering favors, while Muhammad's community is told to remember God; other nations look from blessing to Benefactor, whereas this community looks from Benefactor to blessing, and a blessing must not veil its Giver.
rows.anchor: قال أرباب المعاني ربط سبحانه وتعالى بني إسرائيل بذكر النعمة وأسقطه عن أمة محمد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fulfilling the covenant means completing it without neglect; the covenant accepted at the primordial pact covers faith, obedience, prohibitions, commandments, and specifically Israel's Torah pledge to follow Muhammad.
rows.anchor: الذي قبلتم يوم الميثاق وهو عام في جميع أوامره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Covenant also means a pledge or testament that must be preserved continually; here God's covenant is grammatically annexed to its agent.
rows.anchor: والعهد حفظ الشيء ومراعاته حالا فحالا والمراد منه الموثق والوصية والعهد هنا مضاف إلى الفاعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God fulfills their covenant by completing their reward through gracious acceptance and entry into Paradise; His covenant with them was established through proofs, messengers, revelation, and promised recompense for good works.
rows.anchor: أتمم جزاءكم بحسن الإثابة والقبول ودخول الجنة والعهد يضاف إلى المعاهد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first human fulfillment is uttering the two testimonies, and God's first fulfillment is protecting life and property; the highest human fulfillment is absorption in unity, answered by God's everlasting encounter.
rows.anchor: وأول مراتب الوفاء منا هو الإتيان بكلمتي الشهادة ومن الله حقن المال والدم

rows.speaker: القشيري
rows.claim: Al-Qushayri reads fulfilling the covenant as keeping it in the realm of veiling, while God's fulfillment brings nearness, intimacy, and vision in the realm of union.
rows.anchor: كما قال القشيري {وأوفوا بعهدى} في دار الحجبة {أوف بعهدكم} في دار القربة

rows.speaker: القشيري
rows.claim: Al-Qushayri also hears the worshipper say continually, My Lord, and God answer continually, My servant.
rows.anchor: وأوفوا بعهدي بقولكم أبدا ربي ربي أوف بعهدكم بجوابكم أبدا عبدي عبدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The object-fronted phrase means fear Me: the verb's object is already supplied, the final ya is dropped for ease and rhyme, and the conditional fa implies that if anyone is feared, God alone is to be feared.
rows.anchor: نصب بمحذوف تقديره وإياي ارهبوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear includes guarding oneself; the verse combines promise and warning, requires gratitude and covenant fidelity, and teaches believers to fear God alone through the exclusive fronting of Me.
rows.anchor: والرهبة خوف معه تحرز والآية متضمنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is singled out for an explicit command to believe even though belief in it was already included in the covenant, because it is the highest and central test of fidelity.
rows.anchor: إفراد الإيمان بالقرآن بالأمر به بعد اندراجه تحت العهد لما أنه العمدة القصوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an confirms the Torah because it came as described in it, so Israel's own belief in the Torah strengthens the obligation to accept the book that confirms it.
rows.anchor: حال كون القرآن مصدقا للتوراة لأنه نازل حسبما نعت فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning not to be the first disbelieving group means the originator bears a burden alongside those who imitate him.
rows.anchor: فإن وزر المقتدي يكون على المبتدي كما يكون على المقتدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience helps meet needs by waiting for deliverance and relief while relying on God, or by fasting, which restrains appetite and purifies the soul.
rows.anchor: بانتظار الظفر والفرج توكلا على الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer means turning to it and seeking refuge in it so that needs are granted and hardships repaired; these practices address the strain of relinquishing status and wealth.
rows.anchor: التوسل بالصلاة والالتجاء إليها حتى تجابوا

rows.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
rows.claim: A report says the Prophet resorted to prayer whenever a matter distressed him.
rows.anchor: روي أنه عليه السلام "كان إذا حزبه أمر فزع إلى الصلاة"

rows.speaker: ابن عباس
rows.claim: When Ibn Abbas was told on a journey that his daughter had died, he praised God for the covering and relief, prayed beside the road, then returned to his mount reciting this verse.
rows.anchor: وروي أن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما نعي له بنت وهو في سفر فاسترجع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun refers to seeking help through patience and prayer; this is heavy and difficult except for the humble, who are meek and fearful. Humility may be bodily with submission of heart, or lowered eyes with yielding limbs.
rows.anchor: المخبتين الخائفين والخشوع بالجوارح والخضوع بالقلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer is not burdensome for the humble because absorption in intimate conversation with God makes them unaware of hardship; the Prophet called it the delight of his eye and treated worldly work as toil.
rows.anchor: لأنهم يستغرقون في مناجاة ربهم فلا يدركون ما يجري عليهم من المشاق والمتاعب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In this context, zann means certainty though it can also mean doubt; the word raja can likewise mean security or fear, according to al-Kawashi.
rows.anchor: يوقنون لأن الظن يكون يقينا ويكون شكا فهو من الأضداد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Meeting the Lord means seeing Him and alludes to the scene of presentation and questioning on Judgment Day, explaining reports about meeting God while He is angry.
rows.anchor: معاينوه وهو كناية عن شهود مشهد العرض والسؤال يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative interpretation takes meeting God to mean death, supported by the Prophetic report that whoever loves meeting God is loved by God and whoever dislikes it is disliked by Him.
rows.anchor: قال النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning to God means returning on Resurrection Day to receive recompense for one's deeds.
rows.anchor: ويعلمون أنهم راجعون يوم القيامة إلى الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People without certainty about recompense, hope for reward, or fear of punishment experience only hardship, like hypocrites and ostentatious worshippers.
rows.anchor: وأما الذين لا يوقنون بالجزاء ولا يرجون الثواب ولا يخافون العقاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Patience in enduring harm and obedience is the struggle against the self, restraining it from desires and excess; it is characteristic of prophets and the righteous.
rows.anchor: فالصبر على الأذى والطاعات من باب جهاد النفس وقمعها عن شهواتها

rows.speaker: يحيى بن اليمان
rows.claim: Yahya ibn al-Yaman defines patience as not wishing for a state other than what God allotted and being content with His decree in worldly and afterlife matters; it is like the head to the body.
rows.anchor: قال يحيى بن اليمان : الصبر أن لا تتمنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Persian couplet cited from Hafiz says stone can become ruby through patience, but only through the blood of the liver, emphasizing the cost of patient endurance.
rows.anchor: كويند سنك لعل شود در مقام صبر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives ordinary good deeds tenfold, gives charity in His cause the multiplied reward of a grain producing seven ears, and gives the patient reward without measure while praising them.
rows.anchor: وجعل أجر الصابرين بغير حساب ومدح أهله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A hadith calls God the most patient toward hurtful speech: people ascribe a child to Him, yet He continues to cure and provide them; divine patience here means forbearance, delaying deserved punishment.
rows.anchor: ووصف الله بالصبر إنما هو بمعنى الحلم وهو تأخير العقوبة عن المستحقين لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sinner feels less secure from punishment under the divine attribute Patient than under Forbearing.
rows.anchor: والفرق بين الحليم والصبور أن المذنب لا يأمن العقوبة في صفة الصبور

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: A saying defines humility as treating noble and lowly people equally in justice and humbling oneself in every duty, not merely eating or wearing rough things; outward humility beyond inward humility is hypocrisy.
rows.anchor: وقيل في الخشوع أتريد أن تكون إماما للناس ولا تعرف الخشوع

rows.speaker: سهل بن عبد الله
rows.claim: Sahl says true humility reaches every hair on the body; fear settled in the heart naturally makes the outward form humble, lowered, and respectful.
rows.anchor: قال سهل بن عبد الله لا تكون خاشعا حتى تخشع كل شعرة على جسدك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier Muslims tried to conceal the outward signs of genuine humility; affected displays, staged weeping, and bowed heads to win esteem are blameworthy tricks of Satan and self-delusion.
rows.anchor: وأما المذموم فتكلفه والتباكي ومطأطأة الرأس كما يفعله الجهال

rows.speaker: عمر
rows.claim: As related in al-Qurtubi, Umar spoke loudly enough to be heard, walked quickly, and struck hard; the author presents this as genuine asceticism and humility rather than a staged display.
rows.anchor: وكان عمر رضي الله عنه إذا تكلم أسمع وإذا مشى أسرع وإذا ضرب أوجع

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: The Najmiyya reading takes patience as resisting the ego's desires and prayer as remaining at the threshold of the unseen and the Lord's presence.
rows.anchor: وقال في "التأويلات النجمية" : {واستعينوا بالصبر} عن شهوات النفس

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: In this inward reading, the humble are people whose secrets have received divine self-disclosure so their souls submit; manifestation brings intimacy with God and removes the burden from creation.
rows.anchor: وهم الذين تجلى الحق لأسرارهم فخشعت له أنفسهم

rows.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
rows.claim: Those who are certain of meeting God know through the light of manifestation that they will behold the beauty of the Real and return through divine attractions, each equal to the deeds of humans and jinn.
rows.anchor: {الذين يظنون} أي : يوقنون بنور التجلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israel is told to thank God for manna and quails, cloud shade, water from the stone, and other favors; blessings given to the ancestors obligate their descendants to give thanks, and descendants share their honor.
rows.anchor: يا بنى إسرائيل اذكروا} اشكروا {نعمتى التى أنعمت} بها {عليكم} بإنزال المن والسلوى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Israel's ancestors were favored over the peoples of their own time through knowledge, faith, good works, prophethood, and just kingship, before they changed; the comparison is not with every later community.
rows.anchor: فضلت آباءكم على عالمي زمانهم بما منحتهم من العلم والإيمان والعمل الصالح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary's being chosen above women means women of her own time; Khadija, Aisha, and Fatima were better, and Muhammad's community was the best community, so Israel was not superior to it.
rows.anchor: نساء زمانك فإن خديجة وعائشة وفاطمة أفضل منها

rows.speaker: أبو الليث
rows.claim: Abu al-Layth reports that after Moses returned and found the calf worship, six portions of the tablets were removed, leaving the lawful, unlawful, and needed teachings; the calf was burned and scattered into the sea.
rows.anchor: قال أبو الليث في "تفسيره" : وهذا الطريق أصح

rows.speaker: أبو الليث
rows.claim: The Israelites drank the water containing the calf out of love for it, became physically marked and ill, repented, and were not forgiven until they killed themselves.
rows.anchor: فشربوا من مائه حبا للعجل فظهرت على شفاههم صفرة ورمت بطونهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This community does not need bodily self-killing for repentance; true repentance means returning to God by killing the commanding self that worships the calf of desire.
rows.anchor: وأما هذه الأمة فلا يحتاجون إلى قتل النفس في الصورة وتوبتهم الحقيقية إنما هي الرجوع إلى الله

rows.speaker: المثنوي
rows.claim: The Mathnawi says people have defeated outward enemies but a more dangerous enemy remains within; the self is a dragon, dormant from lacking the means to act, and if empowered like Pharaoh it blocks the way of Moses and Aaron.
rows.anchor: التي تعبد عجل الهوى ، قال في "المثنوي" :

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forty marks a complete cycle across number orders and a perfection of perfection; it is linked to forty days of Adam's clay being kneaded, forty-day stages of embryonic creation, and the forty-year dissolution of the bodily talisman.
rows.anchor: واعلم أن تعيين عدد الأربعين في الميعاد لاختصاصه في الكمالية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night is singled out because worship and nearness to God have special merit at its heart, as reports say the servant is nearest then and God descends nightly; the text also cites night vigil and the Night Journey.
rows.anchor: إن لليل خصوصية في التعبد والتقرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mentioning nights also prevents the assumption that only daytime was appointed for worship, since night is normally associated with rest and stillness.
rows.anchor: والآخر إنه لو ذكر اليوم دون الليل يظن أنه موعود بالتعبد في النهار دون الليل

rows.speaker: با فتادة أفندي
rows.claim: Bafatada Efendi says the Prophet did not specify a forty-day retreat and instead secluded himself in the last ten days; forty days was Moses' appointment, and the Khalwatiyya took their retreat practice from it.
rows.anchor: قال الشيخ الشهير بافتادة أفندي قدس سره أن النبي عليه السلام لم يعين الأربعين بل اعتكف في العشر الأخير
